name: seated open up and under swing on a chair
description: A seated swing that opens the chest and then sweeps the arms underneath, warming up the trunk and shoulders.
instructions: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Swing both arms open to the sides.
Rotate and sweep them under and across your body.
Open back out and alternate directions with a smooth rhythm.
